# Smoke puff

Type: Food | Internal ID: MushroomSmokePuff | Source: Found in the, Ashlands, biome | Usage: Crafting, Eating, Taming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 15 | Max Stamina: 15 | Duration: 15m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Smoke puff is a raw balanced Ashlands-tier food which is used in various recipes.

## Availability

Smoke puffs can be found scattered throughout the Ashlands biome, including on or around rocks or Ashlands ruins. They respawn every 4 hours.

### Crafting

• Fiery svinstew
• Marinated greens
• Mead base: Lingering health
• Smoke bomb
• Sparkling shroomshake

### Taming

• Asksvin
